items.content: Simon语料库中英文 Ideas for IELTS topics Who is this book for? Many students have no ideas or opinions about IETLS writing topics. Even if your grammar is perfect, you will not get a high IELTS score if you do not know what to write. This book is for students who want to go into the writing exam feeling confident that they have excellent ideas, opinions and vocabulary for as many topics as possible How do you get an IELTS score of 7 or higher? The key to a high score is not grammar, it is not your use of words like “moreover” or “in addition”, and it is not your use of phrases like “this is controversial issue nowadays” .

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: To get a high score you need to use good “topic language” (words and phrases that are related to the question topic). You need good ideas in order to answer the question well. How should you prepare for IELTS writing task 2? There is an enormous amount of advice on my website ielts-simon.com. Here is a summary of what I suggest: - Spend more time preparing than testing When you test yourself, you find out what your level is, but you do not learn anything new. You will not improve if you only write test essays.

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: Before writing an essay, study the topic and prepare your ideas, opinions and vocabulary. - Steal my ideas If you only use the vocabulary that you already know, you will not learn anything new, and you will not improve. Practise linking my topic ideas together to write “perfect essays” . See the website for examples of how to do this. - Use this book together with the website The website ielts-simon.com contains lessons and videos that show you how to use the ideas from this book. You can speak to me there if you have any questions.

items.content: Environment环境 Global warming全球变暖 Gases such as carbon dioxide trap heat from the sun 像二氧化碳这样的气体会吸收来自太阳的热量 This causes global temperatures to rise 这导致全球气温上升 This process is known as the greenhouse effect 这个过程被称为温室效应 Human activity is a major factor in the rise of the greenhouse gases 人类活动是温室气体增加的一个主要因素 Factories and vehicles produce emissions and exhaust fumes 工厂和车辆排放废气 Many developing countries are becoming industrialized 许多发展中国家正在工业化 The number of cars on our streets is growing 我们街道上的汽车数量正在增长 Cheap air travel is allowing more people to fly 廉价的航空旅行让更多的人坐飞机出行 Effects of Global Warming全球变暖的影响 Global warming will have a significant impact on our planet 全球变暖将对我们的星球产生重大影响 Rising temperature will cause melting of the polar ice caps 气温上升将导致极地冰盖融化 Sea levels will rise 海平面将会上升 We can expect more extreme weather conditions 我们可以预见更极端的天气状况 Flooding and droughts may become more common 洪水和干旱可能会变得更加普遍 Impacts of humans on the environment人类对环境的影响 The increasing world population is putting pressure on natural resources 不断增长的世界人口给自然资源带来了压力

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: Fossil fuels like oil and gas are running out 石油和天然气等化石燃料正在耗尽 We are destroying wildlife habitats 我们正在破坏野生动物的栖息地 We have cut down enormous areas of rainforest 我们砍伐了大片的雨林 This has led to the extinction of many species of animals and plants 这导致了许多动植物物种的灭绝 Solutions to environment problems环境问题的解决方案 Governments could introduce laws to limit emissions from factories 政府可以出台法律限制工厂的排放 They should invest in renewable energy from solar, wind or water power 他们应该投资太阳能、风能或水力等可再生能源 They could impose “green taxes” on drivers and airlines companies 他们可以对司机和航空公司征收“环保税” Government campaigns should promote recycling 政府应该提倡回收利用 Natural areas and wild animals should be protected 自然区域和野生动物应该受到保护 Individuals should also try to be greener 个人也应该努力变得更环保 We should take fewer flights abroad for holidays 我们应该减少出国度假的航班 We should take public transport rather than driving 我们应该乘坐公共交通工具而不是开车 We should choose products with less packaging 我们应该选择包装较少的产品 We should recycle as much as possible 我们应该尽可能地回收利用 Waste/rubbish废料/垃圾 The amount of waster we produce has increased 我们产生的废物量增加了 This problem is a result of our consumer culture 这个问题是我们的消费文化造成的 Products are not made to last 产品不是用来持久的 If something breaks, we throw it way and buy a new one 如果什么东西坏了,我们就把它扔掉,再买一个新的

items.content: Nuclear Power: Positives核能:积极因素 There are several benefits to build more nuclear power stations 建造更多的核电站有几个好处 Fossil fuel like oil and gas are running out 石油和天然气等化石燃料正在耗尽 Nuclear power is a sustainable energy source 核能是一种可持续能源 It can be used to produce electricity without wasting natural resources 它可以用来发电而不浪费自然资源 It could be replace the use of natural resources like coal, oil or gas 它可以取代煤炭、石油或天然气等自然资源的使用 Nuclear power stations are cleaner than fossil fuel power stations 核电站比化石燃料发电站更清洁 They could help to reduce carbon emissions that cause global warming 它们可以帮助减少导致全球变暖的碳排放 The risks of accidents are being reduced 发生事故的风险正在降低 Nuclear Power: negatives核能:负面影响 Opponents of nuclear power worry about the safety of power stations 反对核能的人担心发电站的安全 The building of new nuclear power stations is unpopular 新建核电站不受欢迎 Nobody wants to live near one 没人想住在这样的地方 Nuclear waste disposal is a significant problem 核废料处理是一个重大问题 There is currently no way to decontaminate radioactive material 目前还没有办法清除放射性物质的污染 People worry that terrorists could steal radioactive materials 人们担心恐怖分子会窃取放射性物质 It is safer to produce energy from solar, wind or water power.

items.content: Negatives of genetic engineering基因工程的负面影响 There are ethical concerns about human genetic engineering 人类基因工程存在伦理问题 Parents might want to choose their children’s characteristics 父母可能想要选择孩子的特点 This would be unnatural 这是不自然的 It would be unacceptable in most religions 这在大多数宗教中是不可接受的 Soldiers could be cloned from the genes of the strongest people 士兵可以从最强壮的人的基因中克隆出来 Clones might be used like robots to do certain jobs 克隆人可以像机器人一样被用来做某些工作 Clones might even be developed just for organ replacements 克隆甚至可能仅仅用于器官移植 Society and human evolution would change completely 社会和人类的进化将彻底改变 Currently, human genetic engineering is prohibited 目前,人类基因工程是被禁止的 Genetically-Modified (GM) foods: Advantages转基因食品:优势 Farmers can produce crops that grow bigger and faster 农民可以生产出长得又大又快的作物 Some GM crops are more resistant to disease or insects 一些转基因作物对疾病或昆虫的抵抗力更强 This could be important for food production in developing countries 这对发展中国家的粮食生产可能很重要 Faster growing cereals, fruit and vegetables will mean more profit 谷物、水果和蔬菜的快速增长将意味着更多的利润 GM foods can be modified to look perfect 转基因食品可以被改造得看起来很完美 They may be more attractive to customers 他们可能对顾客更有吸引力 Genetically-Modified (GM) Foods: Disadvantages转基因食品:缺点 There may be risks involved in the genetic engineering of foods.

items.content: Global issues 全球问题 Problems in developing countries发展中国家的问题 Developing countries face a range if problems 发展中国家面临着一系列问题 Standards of healthcare and education are low 医疗保健和教育水平很低 Life expectancy is usually lower than in developed countries 预期寿命通常低于发达国家 There is a lack of infrastructure, employment and good quality housing 这里缺乏基础设施、就业机会和优质住房 Many people are forced to live in poverty 许多人被迫生活在贫困中 Food, drinking water and basic medicines are in short supply 食品、饮用水和基本药品供应短缺 How to help developing countries如何帮助发展中国家 The best form of help for developing countries is development aid 对发展中国家最好的帮助形式是发展援助 Richer nations can help by investing in long-term projects 富裕国家可以通过投资长期项目来提供帮助 Governments and charities can help by building new houses and schools 政府和慈善机构可以通过建造新房子和学校来提供帮助 Globalization may also help developing countries 全球化也可能帮助发展中国家 Multi-national companies can creating jobs in developing countries 跨国公司可以在发展中国家创造就业机会

items.content: On the other hand, many people emigrate to find work in richer countries 另一方面,许多人移居到较富裕的国家找工作 They often sand money back home to their families 他们经常把钱寄回家给家人 This money helps to improve the standard of living in developing countries 这笔钱有助于提高发展中国家的生活水平 Immigration移民 Some people move to another countries in search of a better life 有些人为了寻求更好的生活而移居到另一个国家 Many immigrants come from less developed countries 许多移民来自欠发达国家 Richer, industrialized countries may offer opportunities for employment 较富裕的工业化国家可能会提供就业机会 Free healthcare and schooling are available in some developed countries 一些发达国家提供免费医疗和教育 Other people migrate to a foreign country to improve their academic qualifications 还有一些人移民到国外以提高他们的学历 Positives of immigration and Multi-cultural societies 移民和多元文化社会的积极因素 From an economic perspective, immigration can be extremely positive 从经济角度来看,移民可能是非常积极的 Many immigrants have skills that are needed in the country they move to 许多移民拥有他们移居的国家所需要的技能 Immigrants who find work contribute to the economy of their new country 找到工作的移民对新国家的经济做出了贡献 Many immigrants send money home to help family members 许多移民寄钱回家帮助家人 Immigration also creates cultural diversity 移民也创造了文化多样性 People of many different nationalities learn to live together 许多不同国籍的人学会一起生活 This can help people to become more open-minded and tolerant 这可以帮助人们变得更加开放和宽容 Negatives of Immigration移民的负面影响 Some people believe that immigrants take jobs that should go to local people

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: 有些人认为移民抢走了本该属于本地人的工作 Some immigrant workers work longer hours for less money 一些移民工人工作时间更长,工资却更少 Companies might pay lower salaries to immigrant workers 公司可能会向移民工人支付较低的工资 Unemployment rates could rise if there are too many immigrants 如果移民过多,失业率可能会上升 Opinions about Immigration对移民的看法 Immigration can help the economy of a country 移民可以帮助一个国家的经济 It can create multi-cultural societies 它可以创造多元文化社会 However, immigration needs to be controlled 然而,移民需要得到控制 In many countries, immigrants need visas or work permit 在许多国家,移民需要签证或工作许可 Governments should stop companies from exploiting immigrant workers 政府应该阻止公司剥削移民工人 Foreign and local workers should have the right to equal pay and conditions 外国工人和本地工人应该享有同工同酬和同等条件的权利 Positives of Globalization全球化的好处 Business of becoming increasingly international 业务变得越来越国际化 Multi-national companies do business across the world 跨国公司在世界各地做生意 Companies like MacDonald’s can be seen on high streets in most cities 在大多数城市的大街上都能看到像麦当劳这样的公司 Goods are produced in one country and sold in many others 商品在一个国家生产,在许多其他国家销售 A global economy means free trade between countries 全球经济意味着国家之间的自由贸易 This can strengthen political relationships 这可以加强政治关系 Globalization can also create opportunities for employment 全球化也能创造就业机会 It encourages investment in less developed countries 它鼓励在欠发达国家投资

items.content: They can influence people’s habits and opinions 他们可以影响人们的习惯和观点 They can create jobs 他们可以创造就业机会 They can regulate the activities of companies such as banks 他们可以监管银行等公司的活动 They can provide resources for schools 他们可以为学校提供资源 They are also responsible for the security and well-being of their citizens 他们还对其公民的安全和福祉负责 They control armed forces and police forces 他们控制着武装部队和警察部队 Public services Governments pay the salaries of public sector workers like police officers and teachers政府支付警察和教师等公共部门工作人员的工资 The necessary money is raised by taxing people’s income 必要的资金是通过对人们的收入征税来筹集的 Free education and healthcare may be provided by the state 国家可提供免费教育和保健 Some governments control public transport systems and even TV channels 一些政府控制公共交通系统甚至电视频道 In other countries, these services are provided by private companies 在其他国家,这些服务是由私营公司提供的 Some people believe that competition between private companies is good 有些人认为私营公司之间的竞争是好的 It helps to improve quality while bringing prices down 这有助于在降低价格的同时提高质量 Other people think that essential services should be free 其他人认为基本服务应该免费 Governments should pay for them 政府应该为此买单 Censorship: Opinion审查:意见 Governments can censor what public sees or reads in the media

items.content: 政府可以审查公众在媒体上看到或读到的内容 To a certain extent censorship is necessary 在某种程度上,审查是必要的 We should use censorship to protect children from violent images 我们应该使用审查制度来保护儿童免受暴力图像的影响 Some computer games involve killing people or committing crimes 一些电脑游戏涉及杀人或犯罪 The Internet also needs to be controlled 互联网也需要控制 Many websites show pornography and violence 许多网站都有色情和暴力内容 There should be age limits for websites and computers games 网站和电脑游戏应该有年龄限制 Parents need to take responsibility for checking what their children watch 父母需要负责检查他们的孩子看什么 It is impossible for governments to control everything we see 政府不可能控制我们所看到的一切 Video cameras in public places公共场所的摄像机 The use of CCTV is becoming widespread 闭路电视的使用越来越普遍 Video cameras have been installed in many public places 许多公共场所都安装了摄像机 They are supposed to protect us and deter criminals 他们应该保护我们,阻止罪犯 Many people think that this surveillance violates our privacy 许多人认为这种监视侵犯了我们的隐私 The authorities could build databases with our pictures and identities 当局可以用我们的照片和身份建立数据库 We should not be treated like criminals 我们不应该被当作罪犯对待 Smart cards: Positives Governments will probably introduce a digital identification card system 政府可能会引入数字身份证系统 Smart cards will have benefits and drawbacks 智能卡有优点也有缺点 They could help to reduce crime 他们可以帮助减少犯罪

items.content: 个人有权保护自己 People can use guns in self defence 人们可以用枪自卫 This deters criminals 这吓阻了罪犯 Why gun ownership should be illegal:为什么拥有枪支应该是非法的: There is a risk of accidents with guns 持枪有发生事故的危险 The number of violent crimes increases when guns are available 当枪支随处可见时,暴力犯罪的数量就会增加 Criminals may be armed 罪犯可能有武器 The police then need to use guns 这时警察就需要使用枪支了 Suicide rates have been shown to rise when guns are available 有证据表明,当枪支可用时,自杀率会上升 Guns create violent societies with high murder rates 枪支造成了高谋杀率的暴力社会 Why polices should use guns为什么警察要使用枪支 Many criminals use weapons 许多罪犯使用武器 The threat of a gun can deter criminals 枪的威胁可以吓退罪犯 Police officers can forces a criminal to surrender 警察可以强迫罪犯投降 It is easier to arrest someone and avoid physical violence 逮捕某人并避免身体暴力更容易 The police may shoot violent criminals in self defence 警察可能出于自卫向暴力罪犯开枪 They can protect the public 他们可以保护公众 They can shoot an escaping criminal who poses a serious danger to the public 他们可以射杀对公众构成严重危险的逃犯 Why police should not carry guns为什么警察不应该携带枪支 There is a risk of accidents and mistakes

items.content: They prevent wars from starting 他们阻止了战争的爆发 Nuclear weapons: Opinion核武器:意见 Nuclear weapons should be prohibited 核武器应该被禁止 Governments should limit the production of nuclear weapons 各国政府应限制核武器的生产 There is a danger of nuclear weapons being obtained by terrorists 恐怖分子有获得核武器的危险 Nuclear weapons cannot be used against terrorist organizations 核武器不能用于对付恐怖组织 Armed Forces: Positives武装力量:积极因素 Armed forces provide security and protection 武装部队提供安全和保护 They deter military attack by another country 他们阻止了另一个国家的军事攻击 They can also be sued to maintain peace within countries 它们也可以被用来维持国家内部的和平 They can be sued to give the police extra support 他们可以被起诉,以给予警方额外的支持 Soldiers are also used to help in emergency situations, such as after a natural disaster 士兵也被用来在紧急情况下提供帮助,比如在自然灾害之后 Armed forces: negatives军队:负面影响 Armies require a lot of funding from governments 军队需要政府提供大量资金 Too much money is spent on weapons and military technology 太多的钱花在武器和军事技术上 This money could be spent on schools, hospitals and other public services 这笔钱可以用于学校、医院和其他公共服务 13.

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: Diet饮食 The human body requires a balanced diet 人体需要均衡的饮食 An unhealthy diet can cause various health problems 不健康的饮食会导致各种健康问题 Obesity, diabetes and heart disease are on the increase 肥胖、糖尿病和心脏病的发病率正在上升 Many people nowadays rely on fast food or pre-prepared meals 现在许多人依赖快餐或预先准备的饭菜 These foods often contain too much fat, salt and sugar 这些食物通常含有过多的脂肪、盐和糖 They are cheap to buy and very easy to prepare 它们很便宜,也很容易准备 Many young people have grown up on a diet of convenience foods 许多年轻人是在吃方便食品的环境中长大的 Populations in developed countries are increasingly overweight 发达国家的人口越来越超重 Exercise锻炼 Regular exercise is essential in maintaining a healthy body 经常运动对保持身体健康是必不可少的 Exercise burns calories and helps to build healthy bones and muscles 运动可以燃烧卡路里,帮助建立健康的骨骼和肌肉 Doctors advise exercising at least three times a week for 20 minutes 医生建议每周至少锻炼三次,每次20分钟 Most people nowadays lead a sedentary lifestyle 现在大多数人过着久坐不动的生活方式 We tend to walk less and do desk jobs 我们倾向于少走路和做办公室工作 Most adults relax by watching television 大多数成年人通过看电视来放松 Children play video games rather than doing outdoor sports 孩子们玩电子游戏而不做户外运动 In the past, people were more active in their jobs and at home 在过去,人们在工作和家庭中更加活跃 Government’s Role政府的角色

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: Governments have a significant role to play in reducing obesity 政府在减少肥胖方面可以发挥重要作用 More and more people, including young children are seriously overweight 越来越多的人,包括幼儿严重超重 They are at risk of heart disease and diabetes 他们有患心脏病和糖尿病的风险 This situation will increase the burden on hospitals and taxpayers 这种情况将增加医院和纳税人的负担 Hospitals rely on the government for money and resources 医院依靠政府提供资金和资源 Governments should promote a healthy diet and regular exercise 政府应提倡健康饮食和经常锻炼 There should be more time for sports on school timetables 学校课程表上应该有更多的运动时间 Unhealthy junk food should be banned from school menus 不健康的垃圾食品应该被禁止出现在学校的菜单上 People need information about what foods contain 人们需要关于食物中含有什么的信息 Food packaging must show the food’s nutritional content 食品包装必须标明食品的营养成分 The British Government recommends eating five portions of fruit and vegetables per day 英国政府建议每天吃五份水果和蔬菜 State Health system: advantages国家卫生系统:优势 Good healthcare should be available to everyone for free 每个人都应该免费获得良好的医疗保健 State healthcare is paid by the government using money from taxes 国家医疗保健由政府用税收支付 Everyone has access to the same quality of care and treatment 每个人都有机会获得同等质量的护理和治疗 Private healthcare is unfair because only wealthy people can afford it 私人医疗是不公平的,因为只有富人才能负担得起 The National Health Service in the UK provides free healthcare for every resident 英国的国民保健服务为每位居民提供免费保健 Private Healthcare: advantages私立医疗保健:优势 State hospitals are often very large and difficult to run 公立医院通常非常大,难以经营

items.content: Private hospitals have shorter waiting lists for operations and appointments 私立医院的手术和预约等候名单较短 Patients can benefit from faster treatment 患者可以从更快的治疗中受益 Many people prefer to pay for more a personal service 许多人更愿意为个人服务付费 Patients have their own room and more comfortable facilities 病人有自己的房间和更舒适的设施 Alternative medicine: Positives替代医学:积极因素 People are increasingly using alternative medicines to treat illnesses. 人们越来越多地使用替代药物来治疗疾病。

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: For example, acupuncture can be used to treat backache 例如,针灸可以用来治疗背痛 Herbal medicines can be used to treat allergies or viruses 草药可用于治疗过敏或病毒 Many patients report positive experiences with these treatments 许多患者报告了这些治疗的积极体验 Some traditional cures have been used for hundreds of years 一些传统疗法已经使用了数百年 Alternative medicine: Negatives替代医学:负面影响 Many alternative medicines have not been tested scientifically 许 多替代药物尚未经过科学测试 They may have no beneficial effect at all 它们可能根本没有任何有益的作用 They may cause unknown side effects 它们可能会引起未知的副作用 People should trust the opinions of qualified doctors 人们应该相信合格医生的意见 An illness could get worse without treatment from a doctor 疾病不经医生治疗可能会恶化 Stress压力 Modern lifestyles are increasingly stressful 现代生活方式的压力越来越大 People work long hours with strict deadlines 人们在严格的截止日期下长时间工作

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.topic: 住房与建筑 · Housing and Architecture
items.content: Our busy lifestyles mean we have less time to relax 我们忙碌的生活方式意味着我们没有多少时间放松 Unemployment is a major cause of stress 失业是造成压力的主要原因 Children may be affected by their parents’ relationship problems 孩子可能会受到父母关系问题的影响 Tests and exams can also cause stress 测试和考试也会造成压力 How to reduce stress如何减轻压力 Stress can be reduced by taking regular exercise and eating a healthy diet 压力可以通过定期锻炼和健康饮食来减轻 It is also important to get sufficient sleep and make leisure time a priority 充足的睡眠和休闲时间也很重要 People should work less overtime and take regular holidays 人们应该少加班,有规律地休假 Schools have started to employ psychologists 学校已经开始聘请心理学家 They can offer emotional support to students 他们可以为学生提供情感支持 They can help students to cope with exam stress 他们可以帮助学生应对考试压力 14.

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.topic: 住房与建筑 · Housing and Architecture
items.content: Housing and Architecture住房与建筑 State/council housing州/委员会住房 In some countries the government provides state or council housing 在一些国家,政府提供国家或理事会住房 This helps people who cannot afford to buy their own house 这有助于那些买不起自己房子的人 It can be argued that state housing creates dependence on the government 可以说,国有住房造成了人们对政府的依赖 People should be rely on the government to look after them 人们应该依靠政府来照顾他们 People have no incentive to earn money and buy their own home 人们没有动力赚钱买自己的房子 Council properties are often made with cheap, poor-quality materials. 市政房屋通常是用廉价、劣质的材料建造的。

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: Old Buildings老建筑 Historic buildings are part of a country’s heritage 历史建筑是国家遗产的一部分 They should be protected 他们应该受到保护 Old buildings are often considered to be works or art 老建筑通常被认为是艺术品 They give character to cities and attract tourists 它们赋予城市特色,吸引游客 They show us how people lived in the past 它们向我们展示了过去人们是如何生活的 We identify countries by architectural symbols like the pyramids in Egypt 我们通过建筑符号来识别国家,比如埃及的金字塔 Governments should spend money on looking after historic buildings 政府应该花钱保护历史建筑 They need regular repairs and maintenance 它们需要定期修理和保养 New buildings should be designed to complement them 应该设计新的建筑来补充它们 Modern/green buildings现代/绿色建筑 Modern buildings should be designed to be environmentally friendly 现代建筑的设计应该是环保的 They should use less energy and produce less waste 他们应该使用更少的能源,产生更少的废物 Modern insulation can make houses more energy-efficient 现代隔热材料可以使房屋更加节能 Solar and wind power can be used to generate electricity 太阳能和风能可以用来发电 Rainwater and waste water can be recycled and used to flush toilets.

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: 雨水和废水可以循环利用,用来冲厕所。 Modern glass buildings take advantage if natural light 现代玻璃建筑充分利用了自然光 15. Language语言

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: English as an international language英语作为一种国际语言 English is widely used around the world 英语在世界范围内被广泛使用 It is becoming a global second language 它正在成为全球第二语言 It is the dominant language of technology, science and international business 它是技术、科学和国际商务的主导语言 International business meetings are regularly held in English 国际商务会议定期用英语举行 The most important textbooks and journals are published in English 最重要的教科书和期刊都是用英文出版的 The ability to speak English is a necessary skill in the modern world 说英语的能力在现代社会是一项必要的技能 Negative of English as an International Language 英语作为国际语言的否定 If one language is dominant, other languages may disappear 如果一种语言占主导地位,其他语言可能会消失 The dominant language brings its own culture 占主导地位的语言带来了自己的文化 American culture has become popular around the world 美国文化在全世界都很流行 Other cultures may be damaged 其他文化可能会受到破坏 As an alternative to English, a new global language could be invented 作为英语的替代品,可以发明一种新的全球语言 It would have no nationality or culture attached to it 它将没有国籍或文化 This could help to promote international peace and understanding 这将有助于促进国际和平与理解 Esperanto is an example of a language that was invented with this aim 世界语就是以这种目的而发明的语言的一个例子 16.

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: Money钱 Money and Society金钱与社会

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: Society has become increasingly materialistic 社会变得越来越物质化 People aspire to earn more money 人们渴望挣更多的钱 They want a bigger house or a better car 他们想要更大的房子或更好的车 We connect wealth and material possessions with happiness and success 我们把财富和物质财富与幸福和成功联系在一起 Brands like “Armani” or ”Mercedes” are status symbols 像“阿玛尼”或“梅赛德斯”这样的品牌是地位的象征 Advertising creates new desires and needs 广告创造了新的欲望和需求 It persuades us to buy the latest styles 它说服我们购买最新款式 Positives of Consumerism消费主义的好处 Consumerism creates employment 消费主义创造就业 It helps to reduce poverty 它有助于减少贫困 It encourages innovation and creativity in business 它鼓励商业上的创新和创造力 We live in a global economy 我们生活在全球经济中 We have a better quality of life 我们有了更好的生活质量 Negatives of Consumerism消费主义的负面影响 Consumerist societies create more waste 消费主义社会制造了更多的浪费 They use more natural resources 他们使用更多的自然资源 They cause damage to the environment 它们对环境造成破坏 Consumerism creates a “throw-away” culture 消费主义创造了一种“一次性”文化 Advertisers tell us who we are and what we want 广告商告诉我们我们是谁,我们想要什么 Wealth does not lead to happiness

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: 财富不能带来幸福 Materialism causes greed and crime 物质主义导致贪婪和犯罪 We should return to traditional values like sharing 我们应该回归传统的价值观,比如分享 17.

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: Personality个性 Happiness个性 Happiness means different things to different people 幸福对不同的人意味着不同的东西 It can be described as a feeling of pleasure or enjoyment 它可以被描述为一种快乐或享受的感觉 People enjoy spending time with family and friends 人们喜欢与家人和朋友共度时光 Hobbies, sports and games can be a source of fun and enjoyment 爱好、运动和游戏可以成为乐趣和享受的源泉 Some people see money as a source of happiness 有些人认为金钱是幸福的源泉 Other people define happiness as something deeper 其他人把幸福定义为更深层次的东西 In order to be truly happy it is necessary to live a good life 为了真正的快乐,有必要过一种美好的生活 We need to feel that we are doing something useful with our lives 我们需要感觉到我们在用生命做一些有用的事情 Some people get a sense of achievement from their work 有些人从他们的工作中获得成就感 Others find happiness in bringing up their children 另一些人则在抚养孩子的过程中找到快乐 Religion or a sense of purpose can also be a source of happiness 宗教信仰或使命感也可以成为幸福的源泉 Success成功 People define success in different ways 人们以不同的方式定义成功 Some people get a sense of achievement from raising a family 有些人从养家糊口中获得成就感 For others, success is defined by wealth or status

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.topic: 运动与休闲 · Sport and Leisure
items.content: 对其他人来说,成功是由财富或地位来定义的 We often think of rich and famous people as being successful in life 我们常常认为富有和著名的人在生活中是成功的 Millionaires like Bill Gates are considered to be successful 像比尔·盖茨这样的百万富翁被认为是成功的 They have risen to the top in their chosen professions 他们在自己选择的职业中已经升到了最高的位置 For some, being successful means achieving personal or professional goals 对一些人来说,成功意味着实现个人或职业目标 They see success as the result of hard work 他们认为成功是努力工作的结果 Success in any field requires long-term planning and effort 任何领域的成功都需要长期的计划和努力 Nature or Nurture先天还是后天 Some people believe that our personalities are determined mainly by genetics 有些人认为我们的性格主要是由基因决定的 We inherit our abilities and talents from our parents 我们从父母那里继承了我们的能力和才华 Others think that our education and upbringing are more important 另一些人认为我们的教育和成长更重要 We develop according to the influences around us 我们根据周围的影响而发展 Our personalities and achievements depend more on nurture than nature 我们的个性和成就更多地取决于教养,而不是天生的 Many people argue that we control our own destinies 许多人认为我们掌握着自己的命运 We can shape our own personalities 我们可以塑造自己的个性 By working hard we can achieve the goal that we put our minds to 通过努力工作,我们可以实现我们下定决心的目标 Many successful people are “self-made” 许多成功人士都是“白手起家”的。

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.topic: 运动与休闲 · Sport and Leisure
items.content: We are not limited by our genetic characteristic or upbringing 我们不受基因特征或教养的限制 18. Sport and Leisure运动及休闲 Arguments against Professional/competitive sport

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.topic: 运动与休闲 · Sport and Leisure
items.content: 反对职业/竞技体育的论点 Sport has become a business 体育已经成为一门生意 Professional sport encourages people to compete for money 职业体育鼓励人们为金钱而竞争 Many sports stars are only concerned about money and fame 许多体育明星只关心金钱和名誉 Some athletes take drugs in order to win at any cost 有些运动员为了赢得比赛不惜一切代价服用药物 Competitors are often selfish and rude 竞争对手往往是自私和粗鲁的 They are not good role models for children 他们不是孩子们的好榜样 All sports should be amateur 所有的运动都应该是业余的 Sports should be leisure activities rather than jobs 体育应该是休闲活动,而不是工作 People should do sporting activities for enjoyment and health reasons 人们应该为了享受和健康的原因进行体育活动 Taking part is more important than winning 参与比获胜更重要 Arguments for Professional sport职业体育的争论 Professional sports are the same as any other business 职业体育和其他行业一样 Many people are employed in the sports industry 许多人受雇于体育产业 People should be able to use their talents to earn a salary 人们应该能够利用自己的才能来赚取薪水 Sports stars entertain millions of people 体育明星为数百万人带来欢乐 Money is necessary to improve facilities and train athletes 改善设施和训练运动员是必要的 The level of professional sport is much higher than that of amateur sport 职业体育运动的水平远远高于业余体育运动的水平 Arguments for Competitive sport竞技体育的理由 Competition is a natural instinct in humans

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.topic: 运动与休闲 · Sport and Leisure
items.content: 竞争是人类的自然本能 In daily life we compete to get jobs or the highest grades 在日常生活中,我们竞争工作或获得最高分 Sports are a safe form of competition 体育运动是一种安全的竞赛形式 Competition is healthy because it pushes us to give our best 竞争是健康的,因为它促使我们全力以赴 Competitors and fans can release energy and aggression 竞争者和粉丝可以释放能量和侵略性 Supporters of teams feel a sense of belonging to a community 球队的支持者会有一种归属感 Opinion: professional sport salaries are too high 观点:职业运动员的薪水太高了 Sports professionals earn too much money 体育专业人士赚的钱太多了 They do not provide a vital service 他们没有提供重要的服务 Football players, for example, earn enormous salaries by simply kicking a ball 例如,足球运动员仅仅靠踢球就能赚取巨额薪水 We could all live happily without professional football 没有职业足球我们也能过得很开心 Life would be difficult without doctors, engineers and other vital professionals.

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.topic: 运动与休闲 · Sport and Leisure
items.content: 没有医生、工程师和其他重要的专业人员,生活会很困难。 Society does not seem to value these professions as highly as professional sport 社会似乎并不像职业体育那样重视这些职业 Sports salaries should be compatible with the wages most people earn 体育运动员的薪水应该与大多数人的工资相适应 Opinion: professional sport salaries are fair 观点:职业运动员的薪水是公平的 It is fair that the best professional earn a lot of money 最好的专业人士挣很多钱是公平的 Sport is a multi-million-pound industry 体育是一个价值数百万英镑的产业 There is a large audience of sports fans 有很多体育爱好者 Sports on television attract many viewers

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.topic: 电视、网络与电话 · Television, Internet, Phones
items.content: 电视上的体育节目吸引了许多观众 Sports stars have dedicated hours of practice to developing their fitness and skills 体育明星们花了很多时间来锻炼身体,提高技能 Only the most talented among them will reach the top 他们当中只有最有才华的人才能达到顶峰 A sports career many only last 10 years 体育生涯很多只持续了10年 Sports fans are willing to pay to support their teams 体育迷愿意花钱支持他们的球队 Sports and Politics体育与政治 Some people think that sport and politics should remain separate 有些人认为体育和政治应该分开 Governments are involved in the hosting of sporting events such as the Olympics. 政府参与举办像奥运会这样的体育赛事。 These events attract investment and create jobs. 这些活动吸引投资,创造就业机会。

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.topic: 电视、网络与电话 · Television, Internet, Phones
items.content: The Olympic Games are an advertisement for the host nation 奥运会是主办国的广告 They attract huge numbers of visitors and sports fans 他们吸引了大量的游客和体育迷 Wealthy countries tend to hold these events 富裕国家倾向于举办这些活动 Developing countries should be given the chance to become hosts 发展中国家应该有机会成为东道主 19.

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.topic: 电视、网络与电话 · Television, Internet, Phones
items.content: Television, Internet, Phones电视,网络,电话 Positives of television电视的优点 Watching television is a good way to relax 看电视是一种很好的放松方式 It is many people’s favorite way to wind down after a hard day at work 这是许多人在辛苦工作一天后最喜欢的放松方式 Television programs can be entertaining and enjoyable 电视节目可以是娱乐和愉快的 Viewers have access to a huge variety of entertainment channels 观众可以接触到各种各样的娱乐频道 Television brings the best comedians, musicians and actors into our homes

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.topic: 电视、网络与电话 · Television, Internet, Phones
items.content: 电视把最好的喜剧演员、音乐家和演员带到我们的家里 Programmers can also be informative and educational 电视把最好的喜剧演员、音乐家和演员带到我们的家里 News coverage makes the public aware of events around the world 新闻报道使公众了解世界各地发生的事件 Documentaries can make learning more interesting 纪录片可以让学习变得更有趣 Negatives of Television电视的负面影响 Television is having a negative impact on society 电视对社会有负面影响 Some people link violence on television with crime rates in the real world 有些人把电视上的暴力与现实世界的犯罪率联系起来 Children copy the behavior they see on the screen 孩子们模仿他们在屏幕上看到的行为 Children are less healthy because they spend less time playing 孩子们不太健康,因为他们玩的时间少了 Advertisers direct their marketing at children 广告商的营销目标是儿童 Most programs do not require much thought 大多数程序不需要太多的思考 Watching TV is a waste of time 看电视是浪费时间 Opinions about Television对电视的看法 Television has many benefits 电视有很多好处 However, it can be addictive 然而,它可能会让人上瘾 Children should play outside rather than sit in front of a screen all day 孩子们应该到外面玩,而不是整天坐在屏幕前 Behaviour shown on TV can influence people 电视上的行为可以影响人们 Parents should choose carefully what their children watch 父母应该仔细选择他们的孩子看什么 Children should not be exposed to violence, swearing or sexual images 儿童不应该接触暴力、脏话或色情图像 Advertising during children’s programs should be strictly controlled 儿童节目中的广告应该严格控制

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.topic: 电视、网络与电话 · Television, Internet, Phones
items.content: TV companies should make more positive, educational programs 电视公司应该制作更多积极的教育节目 Positives of the Internet互联网的优点 There are many advantages to using the Internet 使用互联网有很多优点 It gives us instant access to information on almost any subject 它使我们能够即时获取几乎任何主题的信息 Shops and other services are now available online 商店和其他服务现在都可以在网上买到 People can buy goods and services from the comfort of their homes 人们可以在舒适的家中购买商品和服务 The Internet is starting to replace other forms of entertainment 互联网正开始取代其他形式的娱乐 It has revolutionized communication 它彻底改变了通信方式 We can keep in touch by email or instant messenger services 我们可以通过电子邮件或即时通讯服务保持联系 Video messaging is becoming common for business meetings 视频信息在商务会议中变得越来越普遍 Negatives of the internet互联网的负面影响 Many websites contain offensive content 许多网站含有令人反感的内容 Some sites show violent or sexual images 一些网站显示暴力或色情图片 Parents find it difficult to control what their children see online 父母发现很难控制孩子在网上看什么 They do not always know who their children are chatting to 他们并不总是知道他们的孩子在和谁聊天 With so many websites it is difficult to search for good information 有这么多的网站,很难搜索到好的信息 Criminals increasingly use the Internet to steal people’s money 犯罪分子越来越多地利用互联网窃取人们的钱 Internet compared to newspaper and books互联网与报纸和书籍相比 Newspapers and books are now published online as well as in print

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.topic: 电视、网络与电话 · Television, Internet, Phones
items.content: 报纸和书籍现在既可以在网上印刷,也可以在网上出版 We can read the news in any language from any country in the world 我们可以阅读世界上任何国家的任何语言的新闻 It costs nothing to publish or access information on the Internet 在互联网上发布或获取信息不需要任何费用 The Internet allows anybody to publish their own writing 互联网允许任何人发表自己的作品 Newspaper articles and books are written by professionals 报纸文章和书籍都是由专业人士撰写的 Professionals produce better quality writing than amateur 专业人士比业余人士写的文章质量更好 People still buy newspapers and books because they are portable 人们仍然购买报纸和书籍,因为它们便于携带 People do not like reading from a screen 人们不喜欢在屏幕前阅读 Positives of Mobile Phones手机的优点 The mobile phone is the most popular gadget in today’s world 手机是当今世界上最流行的小工具 Mobile phones have revolutionized the way we communicate 移动电话彻底改变了我们的交流方式 We can stay in touch with family, friends and colleagues wherever we are 无论我们身在何处,我们都可以与家人、朋友和同事保持联系 Users can send text messages, surf the Internet, take photos and listen to music 用户可以发短信、上网、拍照和听音乐 Mobiles have also become fashion accessories 手机也成为了时尚配饰 Negatives of Mobile Phones手机底片 Mobiles phones can be a problem in some public places 在一些公共场所,手机可能是个问题 Ringing phones cause disturbance in cinemas and school lessons 手机铃声会干扰电影院和学校上课 Some people are not aware that others can hear their conversations 有些人没有意识到别人可以听到他们的谈话 Mobile phones may also interfere with electronic equipment 移动电话也可能干扰电子设备 Their waves could cause damage to our brains 它们的电波可能会对我们的大脑造成损害

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照

items.content: Losing traditional skills失去传统技能 Because of industrialization and global trade, many traditions have disappeared 由于工业化和全球贸易,许多传统已经消失 Global advertising encourages everyone to buy the same products 全球广告鼓励每个人购买相同的产品 Most products are now made in factories 现在大多数产品都是在工厂生产的 Machinery has replaced skilled human labour 机器已经取代了熟练的人类劳动 Factory work is boring and leaves people feeling unfulfilled 工厂的工作很无聊,让人感到没有成就感 Goods are produced very quickly and in large numbers 商品生产得很快,而且数量很大 Products are cheaper, which means that more people can buy them 产品更便宜,这意味着更多的人可以购买它们 Examples例子 Clothes are mass produced in standard sizes 衣服是按标准尺寸批量生产的 People wear similar clothes, rather than traditional costumes 人们穿着相似的衣服,而不是传统的服装 Jeans and T-shirt are now worn throughout the world 牛仔裤和t恤现在在全世界都穿 Historic buildings took skilled craftsmen years to build 历史建筑需要熟练的工匠数年才能建成 Modern concrete, steel and glass buildings are built in only weeks or months 现代的混凝土、钢铁和玻璃建筑只需几周或几个月就能建成 There are fewer people who can create hand-made goods 能制作手工制品的人越来越少了 Traditional customs传统的风俗 Traditional customs are still important during weddings and religious festivals 在婚礼和宗教节日期间,传统习俗仍然很重要 People wear traditional costumers and eat special foods 人们穿着传统的服装,吃特殊的食物 It is important to maintain our different cultural identities

items.content: Transport运输 Traffic problems交通问题 Traffic congestion is caused by commuters travelling to work 交通堵塞是由通勤者上班造成的 Most people live in the suburbs outside city centre 大多数人住在市中心以外的郊区 Commuters tend to travel at the same time of day 通勤者往往在一天中的同一时间出行 They tend to travel alone 他们倾向于独自旅行 Cars and road space are not used efficiently 汽车和道路空间没有得到有效利用 This causes traffic jams during the rush hour 这会导致高峰时间的交通堵塞 Traffic solutions交通解决方案 In order to reduce traffic we should change our working habits 为了减少交通,我们应该改变我们的工作习惯 The internet can now be used to connect people互 联网现在可以用来联系人们 More people could work from home 更多的人可以在家工作 Meetings can be held as video conferences 会议可以以视频会议的形式举行 Workers could be given flexible timetables 工人可以有灵活的时间表 Another solution would be to tax drivers 另一个解决方案是对司机征税 Workers should share their cars and travel together 员工应该共用汽车,一起出行 In London, for example, there is a congestion charge 例如,在伦敦征收拥堵费 This helps to raise money for better public transport

items.content: 这有助于为改善公共交通筹集资金 Public transport needs to be reliable and efficient 公共交通需要可靠和高效 Positives of Public transport公共交通的优点 We need to reduce our dependence on cars 我们需要减少对汽车的依赖 Parking a car can be extremely difficult in big cities 在大城市停车是一件极其困难的事 Well-designed transport systems are comfortable and convenient 精心设计的交通系统既舒适又方便 Modern public transport can be fast and cheap 现代公共交通又快又便宜 Public transport can help to reduce pollution in cities 公共交通可以帮助减少城市污染 Investment in buses and trains will ease traffic congestion 投资公共汽车和火车将缓解交通拥堵 Buses can be given special lands to avoid traffic 公共汽车可以获得特殊的土地以避开交通堵塞 Negatives of public transport公共交通的负面影响 Public transport if often slow and unreliable 公共交通通常又慢又不可靠 Metro systems and trains are often dirty and crowded 地铁系统和火车经常又脏又拥挤 People feel like “sardines in a can” 人们觉得自己像“罐头里的沙丁鱼” Cars are much more comfortable 汽车要舒服得多 Road safety道路安全 Driving while tired or drunk is extremely dangerous 疲劳或醉酒驾驶是非常危险的 Mobile phones can be a dangerous distraction for drivers 手机可能会让司机分心 They draw the driver’s attention away from the road 他们把司机的注意力从路上引开了 The use of phones while driving has been banned in many countries

items.content: Water水 Importance of clean water洁净水的重要性 Water is as necessary natural resource 水是必不可少的自然资源 Humans need access to clean, safe drinking water in order to live 人类需要获得清洁、安全的饮用水才能生存 Poor water quality is a major cause of disease and death in some countries 在一些国家,水质差是导致疾病和死亡的一个主要原因 Water usually needs to be treated before we can drink it 水通常需要经过处理才能饮用 Developing countries often lack the means to treat and supply water to citizens 发展中国家往往缺乏处理和向公民供应水的手段 Developed countries tend to have much better sanitation 发达国家的卫生条件要好得多 Citizens have access to clean tap water 市民可以使用干净的自来水 Drinking water is not contaminated by sewage or waste water 市民可以使用干净的自来水 The supply of clean water would improve public health in many developing countries 清洁水的供应将改善许多发展中国家的公共卫生 Water supply水的供应 Urban life would be impossible without water supply systems 没有供水系统,城市生活是不可能的

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: These systems are massive engineering projects 这些系统是大型工程项目 Many professionals are involved in their planning, construction and maintenance 许多专业人士参与了它们的规划、建造和维护 The supply and distribution of water are major concerns 水的供应和分配是主要问题 Water is becoming scarce in some countries 在一些国家,水变得越来越稀缺 Areas that suffer droughts often need to import water 遭受干旱的地区经常需要进口水 As populations grow, there is more pressure on water supplies 随着人口的增长,水供应的压力也越来越大 This could lead to a water crisis 这可能会导致水危机 Water and politics水与政治 The supply of water is also an important political issue 水的供应也是一个重要的政治问题 Huge amount of water are needed for agriculture and industry 农业和工业需要大量的水 The irrigation of crops accounts for a large proportions of water use 农作物的灌溉占用水量的很大比例 A water crisis could lead to political conflicts or even wars 水危机可能导致政治冲突甚至战争 Argument: water should be free论点:水应该是免费的 Some people believe that water should be free for everyone 有些人认为每个人都应该免费用水 Governments should supply water to all homes at no cost 政府应该免费向所有家庭供水 Private companies should not be allowed to profit from this natural resource 私人公司不应该被允许从这种自然资源中获利 Money from taxes can be used to pay for water supply systems 来自税收的钱可以用来支付供水系统 Argument: water should not be free论点:水不应该是免费的 If water is free, people take it for granted 如果水是免费的,人们认为它是理所当然的

items.content: They may be promoted within the organization 他们可能会在组织内部得到提升 They demonstrate loyalty 他们表现出忠诚 Experienced staff can be trusted with more responsibility 有经验的员工可以承担更多的责任 They become part of a team 他们成为了团队的一部分 There is a clearly defined path for development 发展道路十分明确 The benefits of not staying in the same job不做同一份工作的好处 People often change jobs in order to further their career 人们经常为了事业的发展而换工作 Another company may offer a promotion or a higher salary 另一家公司可能会提供升职或更高的薪水 People who change jobs can gain experience 换工作的人可以获得经验 They can learn different skills 他们可以学习不同的技能 Changing jobs is interesting and challenging 换工作既有趣又具有挑战性 People can retrain in a different occupation 人们可以在不同的职业中接受再培训 In a fast-changing world workers need to be flexible 在一个快速变化的世界里,员工需要灵活应变 People need to develop a range of experience and skills 人们需要发展一系列的经验和技能

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: Self-employment自主创业 Nowadays, it is easy to set up a company 如今,成立一家公司很容易 The Internet provides a global marketplace 如今,成立一家公司很容易 Self-employment offers greater freedom than working for a company 自主创业比为公司工作更自由 However, there are risks to starting a new business 然而,创业也有风险 Self-employed people may face financial difficulties 自雇人士可能面临财务困难 Many businesses fail to make a profit 许多企业没有盈利 There is less stability in self-employment 自营职业的稳定性较差 There are no benefits like pensions, sick pay and holiday pay 没有养老金、病假工资和假期工资等福利 Self-employment involved hard work, long hours and total responsibility 自主创业需要努力工作、长时间工作和负全部责任 Unemployment失业 Unemployment is a big problem for individuals, communities and society 失业是个人、社区和社会的大问题 Some people are unable to find a job 有些人找不到工作 They may not have the sufficient level of education or qualifications 他们可能没有足够的教育水平或资格 They may find themselves homeless 他们可能会发现自己无家可归 Unemployment causes frustration and stress 失业导致沮丧和压力 Jobless people may become involved in crime as a means to get money 失业的人可能会为了赚钱而参与犯罪 The unemployed need careers advice 失业者需要职业建议 Governments need to provide vocational courses and retraining 政府需要提供职业课程和再培训 Unemployment benefits: positives失业救济金:积极因素

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: Some governments pay unemployment benefits in order to help jobless people 一些政府支付失业救济金是为了帮助失业者 Unemployed people need financial support until they find a new job 失业者在找到新工作之前需要经济支持 By claiming benefits they can continue to pay for their homes 通过申领救济金,他们可以继续支付住房费用 The benefits system helps to reduce poverty, homelessness and crime 福利制度有助于减少贫困、无家可归和犯罪 Unemployment benefits: negatives失业救济金:负面影响 Some people claim benefits rather than working 有些人领取福利而不工作 They become dependent on the government 他们变得依赖政府 They are not motivated to find a job 他们没有动力去找工作 The benefits system is a burden on taxpayers 福利制度是纳税人的负担 All citizens should work to earn a living and support themselves 所有公民都应该工作谋生,养活自己 Receiving benefits affects people’s self esteem 接受福利会影响人们的自尊 Work/Life Balance工作和生活的平衡 It is important to achieve a balance between work time and leisure or family time 在工作时间和休闲或家庭时间之间取得平衡是很重要的 Too much work can result in stress and poor health 过多的工作会导致压力和健康状况不佳 “workaholics” may neglect their families and friends “工作狂”可能会忽视他们的家庭和朋友 People need to take regular holidays 人们需要定期休假 Companies should be expect employees to work overtime 公司应该期待员工加班 Nowadays, many people work part-time or have flexible working hours 现在,许多人兼职或有灵活的工作时间 Technology allow people to work from home 科技使人们可以在家工作

items.title: Simon 写作观点库 · 中英对照
items.content: Many companies provide childcare facilities 许多公司提供托儿设施 A good work/ life balance can raise job satisfaction 良好的工作和生活平衡可以提高工作满意度 Happy, healthy workers are more productive 快乐、健康的员工工作效率更高 Technology and work技术与工作 Internet, fax and mobile phone technologies have revolutionized working life 互联网、传真和移动电话技术已经彻底改变了工作生活 Workers can communicate via email, online networks and video conferencing 员工可以通过电子邮件、在线网络和视频会议进行交流 Technology can connect workers in different countries 技术可以把不同国家的工人联系起来 It gives people more freedom 它给了人们更多的自由 It can also save time and money 它还可以节省时间和金钱 Some people believe that offices could disappear in the future 有些人认为办公室在未来会消失 Virtual online offices may replace them 虚拟在线办公室可能会取代它们 Child labour童工 In some countries, children are exploited 在一些国家,儿童受到剥削 They do repetitive jobs for very low pay 他们做重复性的工作,工资很低 Children are often used in agriculture and factory work 他们做重复性的工作,工资很低 The employment of children is prohibited in other countries 其他国家禁止雇用儿童 Many people think that children should be free to enjoy their childhood 许多人认为孩子应该自由地享受他们的童年 Governments should make education a priority 政府应该把教育放在首位 They should build new schools 他们应该建新学校 They should supply the resources to educate children
